cues.en: If you are not already familiar with this title, then it refers to this funny observation that someone found and it kind of went viral and got turned into a meme.
cues.zh: 如果你還不知道這個標題，它指的是有人發現的一個有趣現象，後來爆紅，變成迷因。

cues.en: So basically, ChatGPT has a lot of difficulties with tasks like spelling words and counting the number of target letters in a particular word.
cues.zh: 基本上，ChatGPT 很不擅長拼字，或計算特定單字裡，某個字母出現的次數。

cues.en: Now, at first glance, this seems pretty hilarious.
cues.zh: 乍看之下，這真的很好笑。

cues.en: I mean, here we are worried that AI is going to become so advanced and hostile that it overthrows civilization,
cues.zh: 我們還在擔心 AI 變得太先進、太有敵意，最後推翻文明，

cues.en: kills most humans, and enslaves the rest, and yet it literally cannot count the number of R's in the word strawberry.
cues.zh: 殺死大部分人類、奴役其他人，結果它連 strawberry 裡有幾個 r，都數不出來。

cues.en: Okay, I put this box over here because there's a very simple solution to get this to work.
cues.zh: 我在這裡放了這個框，因為有個非常簡單的解法。

cues.en: But first I want to demonstrate the problem in code, and then I'll come back to the practical solution.
cues.zh: 不過，先用程式示範問題，再回頭談實際解法。

cues.en: I will use GPT four tokenizer here.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 GPT-4 tokenizer。

cues.en: So I'm installing and then importing and getting that tokenizer.
cues.zh: 先安裝、匯入，再取得 tokenizer。

cues.en: Okay so here I'm going to encode the word strawberry, and then print out all of the tokens that make up strawberry.
cues.zh: 接著編碼 strawberry，再印出組成它的所有 token。

cues.en: So three tokens in the word strawberry.
cues.zh: strawberry 這個字有三個 token。

cues.en: As you know from previous videos in this course, we're likely to get a different result if we do.
cues.zh: 如本課程前幾支影片所學，如果改成

cues.en: Space strawberry, which is actually one word, but for now we can work with no space, just the word strawberry and we get str, r and berry.
cues.zh: 前面帶空白的 strawberry，結果可能不同；那會是一個 token。目前先用無空白的 strawberry，得到 str、r（此片段字幕疑誤）與 berry。

cues.en: Now the token for r the just the letter R is 81 and you can already see that token 81 does not appear
cues.zh: 單一字母 r 的 token 是 81。你已經可以看到，token 81 並沒有出現

cues.en: in the word strawberry, certainly not in this version, and also obviously not in the single token version of strawberry.
cues.zh: 在 strawberry 裡，至少這個版本沒有；而只有一個 token 的版本，顯然也沒有。

cues.en: So now we can say does the letter R, or I should say the token R appear in strawberry.
cues.zh: 所以，現在可以問，字母 r，或者應該說，r 這個 token，有沒有出現在 strawberry 裡？

cues.en: And the answer is no.
cues.zh: 答案是沒有。

cues.en: There are no R's in strawberry.
cues.zh: strawberry 裡沒有 r。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: It's kind of ridiculous when you understand how tokenization works, but it is very insightful.
cues.zh: 理解斷詞的運作後，這看似荒謬，卻很有啟發。

cues.en: So you can see that when you ask ChatGPT a question like, does this thing appear in this other thing?
cues.zh: 可以看到，當你問 ChatGPT，某個東西是否出現在另一個東西裡，

cues.en: This is what ChatGPT is doing.
cues.zh: ChatGPT 做的就是這件事。

cues.en: ChatGPT is saying, I know what an R is.
cues.zh: 它會說：我知道 r 是什麼，

cues.en: It's 81.
cues.zh: 就是 81。

cues.en: I know what strawberry is.
cues.zh: 我知道 strawberry 是什麼，

cues.en: It's these three tokens.
cues.zh: 就是這三個 token。

cues.en: Does this thing appear in this thing?
cues.zh: 這個東西，有出現在這些東西裡嗎？

cues.en: The answer is no.
cues.zh: 答案是沒有。

cues.en: Or, you know you're going to get some other weird answer that isn't accurate, because ChatGPT is just trying to figure out what to do with this.
cues.zh: 或者，得到其他奇怪、不正確的答案，因為 ChatGPT 只是在嘗試理解該怎麼處理。

cues.en: Again, as I mentioned in previous videos, ChatGPT does not know the word strawberry.
cues.zh: 如前幾支影片所說，ChatGPT 並不知道 strawberry 這個單字。

cues.en: What ChatGPT knows is these three tokens, and it also knows a lot of context.
cues.zh: 它知道的是這三個 token，以及許多上下文。

cues.en: So ChatGPT will know that these three tokens often appear in sequence when people are talking or writing
cues.zh: 所以，ChatGPT 知道，人們在談論或書寫

cues.en: about, I don't know, summer and fruit and healthy and I don't know, shakes like fruit shakes and things like that.
cues.zh: 夏天、水果、健康，以及水果奶昔之類的事情時，這三個 token 經常依序出現。

cues.en: It doesn't know that this is a word that contains three R's.
cues.zh: 它不知道，這是一個包含三個 r 的單字。

cues.en: Okay, so what do we do?
cues.zh: 那麼，該怎麼辦？

cues.en: I'm going to get to the practical solution in a moment.
cues.zh: 稍後會談實際解法。

cues.en: But first let me just show you that when we decode strawberry.
cues.zh: 不過，先示範把 strawberry 解碼。

cues.en: So this just to make sure this is clear.
cues.zh: 為了確認這點很清楚，

cues.en: So this strawberry variable, this is the encoded version of strawberry.
cues.zh: strawberry 這個變數，是 strawberry 的編碼版本，

cues.en: And it's actually these three numbers but represented as text.
cues.zh: 其實就是這三個數字，只是以文字形式顯示。

cues.en: We can decode this back to text.
cues.zh: 可以把它解碼回文字，

cues.en: And that gives us this list of characters or an array of characters.
cues.zh: 就得到這個字元串列，或字元陣列：

cues.en: Strawberry.
cues.zh: strawberry。

cues.en: And let me see.
cues.zh: 讓我看看。

cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 對。

cues.en: So now we can actually say the decoded version of the letter R as a string.
cues.zh: 現在，就可以使用解碼後、以字串表示的字母 r。

cues.en: And now we can actually count how many times in the string strawberry does the string R appear.
cues.zh: 然後實際計算，字串 strawberry 中，字串 r 出現幾次。

cues.en: And then we get a correct answer of three.
cues.zh: 接著，得到正確答案：三次。

cues.en: And that leads me to my practical conclusion from this video, which is the solution.
cues.zh: 這就帶到這支影片的實務結論，也就是解法。

cues.en: So the solution is to ask ChatGPT to solve the problem using code instead of using its own internal representations.
cues.zh: 請 ChatGPT 用程式解題，而不是用它自己的內部表示。

cues.en: GPT is actually quite good at solving these kinds of simple language tasks when you allow it to use
cues.zh: 只要允許 GPT 使用 Python 這類工具，明確寫出字串或

cues.en: tools like Python to write out the string or whatever the task is explicitly, and then interpret the result of the code.
cues.zh: 其他任務內容，再解讀程式結果，它其實很擅長這類簡單語言任務。

cues.en: Same goes for mathematics, like arithmetic.
cues.zh: 數學也一樣，例如算術。

cues.en: If you want ChatGPT to solve a math problem like an arithmetic problem, unless it's a like conceptual
cues.zh: 如果想請 ChatGPT 解算術之類的數學題，除非是概念性、

cues.en: theoretical problem, it's much better to ask the language model to write Python code that implements
cues.zh: 理論性的問題，否則，請語言模型寫 Python 程式，實作

cues.en: the equation, rather than asking it to solve the equation on its own.
cues.zh: 那個算式，會比要求它自行解算好得多。

cues.en: Okay, so I did want this lecture to be a little bit of light heartedness and fun.
cues.zh: 這一講，原本想輕鬆、有趣一點。

cues.en: But there is an important point here, which is to remind you that language models do not work with text the way that we humans read and write and think about text and language.
cues.zh: 不過，這裡有個重要重點：語言模型處理文字的方式，和人類閱讀、書寫、思考文字與語言的方式不同。

cues.en: Instead, language models work with embedding vectors which come from tokens.
cues.zh: 語言模型處理的是來自 token 的嵌入向量。

cues.en: Now, sometimes those tokens and their embeddings map onto our conceptualization of how language is written out, but that is usually not the case.
cues.zh: 有時候，這些 token 及其嵌入，符合人類對文字書寫方式的概念，但通常並非如此。
